portal.title: Your business page in Portal
portal.description: Clients find you in Portal and book appointments there. From here you control what they see.
portal.memberNote: The page can be changed by the owner, admins and the Portal app manager.
portal.preview: See how it looks in Portal

invite.title: Join {afacere}'s team
invite.roleDesc: Your role: {role}. You'll have access to:
invite.emailNote: This is the address your invitation was sent to.
invite.termsLabel: I accept the Terms and Privacy Policy
invite.termsDesc: You can read them anytime in Settings.
invite.expiredBody: Invitations are valid for 7 days. Request a new one: we'll forward the request to {name} and you'll receive the new link by email.

requested.title: We sent the request
requested.body: You’ll get the new link by email as soon as {name} sends it again.

revoked.title: This invitation is no longer valid
revoked.body: If this is a mistake, ask the person who invited you for a new invitation.

used.title: You’ve already used this invitation
used.body: Sign in with your email and password.

usageMeter.atLimitHint: Nothing you already have will be lost. To add more, buy an add-on or request another subscription.
usageMeter.onlyOwnerBuys: Add-ons can only be purchased by {who} (owner).

common.footerAccount: You received this email because {email} is used for a Ventora account.
common.footerInvitation: You received this email because someone invited {email} to Ventora.

hub.subject: Choose a new password for your Ventora account
hub.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your Ventora account.
hub.validity: The link is valid for one hour and works only once. Once you change your password, we sign you out on every device, so only you have access to your account.
hub.notRequested: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

founder.subject: Reset your Ventora Founder password
founder.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your Ventora Founder account.
founder.validity: The link is valid for one hour and works only once. All open sessions will be closed, and you'll still be asked for your two-step authentication code when you sign in.
founder.notRequested: If you didn't ask for this, write to {supportEmail} right away. Someone may be trying to access your account.

passwordChanged.subject: Your Ventora password was changed
passwordChanged.pre: The change was made on {date}, at {time}. If it wasn't you, read this email.
passwordChanged.title: Your account password was changed
passwordChanged.leadReset: The password for {email} was changed on {date}, at {time}. We've signed you out on all devices.
passwordChanged.leadAccount: The password for {email} was changed on {date}, at {time}. We've signed you out on your other devices.
passwordChanged.ifYou: If it was you, you don't need to do anything.
passwordChanged.notYou: Wasn't you? Choose a new password right away from "Forgot your password?" and write to us at {supportEmail}.
passwordChanged.why: You're receiving this email because your Ventora account password changed. It's a security email: we send it for every password change and it can't be turned off.

member.subject: {inviterName} invited you to {businessName} on Ventora
member.intro: {inviterName} invited you to join the {businessName} team on Ventora, with the {roleName} role.
member.resentNotice: This is a new link. The one you received earlier no longer works.
member.validity: The invitation is valid for 7 days, until {expiresDate}.
member.existingAccount: If you already have a Ventora account, sign in with your email and password, and {businessName} will appear next to your other businesses. If not, you'll choose a password when you open the link.
member.notExpected: Weren't expecting this invitation? You can ignore this email. No account is created unless you accept.

owner.subject: {businessName} is ready on Ventora
owner.intro: We've set up {businessName} on Ventora. You'll be its owner: you set it up, invite your team and choose the apps.
owner.validity: The link is valid for 30 days, until {expiresDate}.
owner.firstLogin: The first time you sign in, you'll choose a password and turn on two-step authentication, so your business is protected from the start.
owner.questions: Any questions? Just reply to this email and we'll help.

ownerRecovery.subject: Two-step authentication on your account has been reset
ownerRecovery.intro: At your request ({ticketRef}), the Ventora team reset two-step authentication on your account. We also closed all open sessions.
ownerRecovery.passwordReset: We also reset your password. Choose a new one using the link below, valid for one hour:
ownerRecovery.nextSteps: What happens next: the next time you sign in, you'll turn on two-step authentication again with an authenticator app. Until then, you can't make changes as owner of {businessName}. Keep your new backup codes somewhere safe.
ownerRecovery.notRequested: If you didn't ask for this, write to us right away at {supportEmail}. We'll look into what happened immediately.

supportSession.subject: The Ventora team has support access to {businessName}
supportSession.intro: {founderName} from the Ventora team opened a support session for {businessName}, for request {ticketRef}.
supportSession.scope: During the session, the Ventora team can only view your business data to resolve the request. They can't change data, can't see passwords and don't change anything about your team or subscription.
supportSession.until: The session closes automatically on {date}, at {time}.
supportSession.close: You can close it at any time in Ventora, from the support session banner.
supportSession.notRequested: If you didn't ask for help, close the session and write to us at {supportEmail}.
supportSession.footer: You're receiving this email because you're the owner of {businessName} in Ventora.

banner.title: Support session active
banner.message: {founderName} from the Ventora team can view your business data until {expiresAt}.
banner.readOnly: Read only: they can't change data, members, passwords or the subscription.
banner.closeConfirm: Close the support session? The Ventora team loses access immediately.

sessions.title: Support sessions
sessions.lead: The Ventora team can see your business data only during a support session: read-only, and only until the time set. Here you can see who, why and when.

request.title: Forgot your password?
request.lead: Enter your account's email address and we'll send you a link to set a new password.

error.format: This address looks incomplete. Check the part after @.
error.reqs: The password doesn't meet all the requirements below yet.

limit.title: You've tried too many times
limit.body: You can ask for a new link after {time}.

offline.title: We can't connect you right now
offline.body: Check your internet connection and try again.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: If {email} belongs to a Ventora account, we've sent a link there to set a new password.
sent.validity: The link is valid for one hour.
sent.help: Can't see the email? Check your spam or promotions folder too.
sent.resendWait: You can ask for another link in a minute.
sent.resent: We've sent another link. Use the newest one.

new.title: Choose a new password
new.label: New password
new.signOutNote: When you save it, we'll sign you out on all devices.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Links for a new password are valid for one hour. Ask for a new one and we'll email it to you.

used.title: You've already used this link
used.body: Each link works only once. If you've already chosen your new password, sign in with it.

done.title: Your password is changed
done.signedOut: We've signed you out on all devices.
done.body: Sign in again with your new password on each device you use.
done.twoStep: After your password, we'll also ask for the code from your authenticator app.

email.securityRow: Security emails: you always get them, for example when your account password changes.

error.wrongCode: That code doesn't match. Enter the code your app shows now.
error.backupWrong: That code doesn't match or has already been used. Try another code from your list.

s1.title: Protect your account
s1.leadOwner: The owner account can reach everything, so we protect it with a second step.
s1.leadMember: A second step protects your account even if someone learns your password.
s1.leadFounder: A Founder account can reach every business, so we protect it with a second step. In Founder it's required for everyone.
s1.how: After your password, we'll also ask for a code from the authenticator app on your phone.
s1.scan: Scan the code with your authenticator app
s1.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
s1.manual: Can't scan? Enter the key below in the app.

s2.title: Enter the code from the app
s2.lead: The app now shows a 6-digit code for Ventora.

locked.title: You've tried too many times
locked.body: You can try again in 15 minutes, at {time}.

s3.title: Save your backup codes
s3.lead: If you don't have your phone with you, sign in with one of these codes. Each one works once.
s3.once: This is the only time you'll see them.
s3.confirmHelp: Tick this once you've downloaded or copied them.

apps.body: Any authenticator app works, for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password. If you don't have one, install it from Google Play or the App Store.
apps.how: In the app, add a new account and scan the code on this page.

verify.title: One more step
verify.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
verify.leadBackup: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you turned on two-step sign-in.
verify.useApp: Use the code from the app

locked.title: Your account is locked for now
locked.body: There were too many wrong attempts. You can sign in again after {time}.

expired.title: More than 10 minutes have passed
expired.body: For your security, sign in again with your email and password.

verify.noAccess: I can't use my phone or my codes

recovery.title: Get back into your account
recovery.body: Write to us from your account's email address and we'll help you get back in once we've confirmed who you are.

backupLeft.title: You signed in with a backup code
backupLeft.few: Only {n} backup codes left. Generate new codes so you don't run out.
backupLeft.one: You have one backup code left. Generate new codes so you don't run out.
backupLeft.none: You've used your last backup code. Generate new codes so you can still sign in if you lose your phone.

codes.title: Backup codes
codes.lead: Use them if you don't have your phone with you. You see them only once, when you generate them.
codes.oldStop: When you generate new codes, the old ones stop working.
codes.confirmTitle: Confirm with the code from your app
codes.confirmLead: To generate new codes, enter the code showing now in your authenticator app.
codes.newDone: You have new codes. The old ones no longer work.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.lead: Sign in to your Ventora account.
signIn.remember: Keep me signed in on this device for 30 days
signIn.inviteOnly: No account? Accounts are created by invitation only. If you received one, open the link in the email and choose your password.

error.title: The email or password is incorrect

limit.title: You’ve tried too many times
limit.body: Try again in 15 minutes or choose a new password.

ui.noNotificationsHint: We’ll tell you here when something needs you.

chooseBusiness.title: Choose a business
chooseBusiness.lead: You work in {count} businesses. Switch between them anytime from the top bar.
chooseBusiness.remember: Open the last business directly next time
chooseBusiness.missing: Missing a business? Ask its owner for an invitation.
chooseBusiness.stoppedNote: A business marked “Access paused” can’t be opened right now. For details, write to us at {email}.

team.title: Team
team.lead: Who works at {business}, in which role and with access to which apps.

form.title: Invite someone to {business}
form.lead: They’ll get an email with a link that’s valid for 7 days.
form.roleMemberDesc: Uses the apps you choose below.
form.roleAdminDesc: Has access to every app and can invite people and change roles and app access.
form.appsHelp: You can change them any time from “App access”.
form.appsAdmin: An admin has access to all of the business’s apps.
form.errorEmail: Enter the full address, like name@example.com.
form.errorInvited: You already sent an invitation to {email} on {date}, and it’s still waiting for a reply.
form.sentBody: It stays under “Pending invitations” until it’s accepted or until {date}, when it expires.

team.actionError: We couldn’t save the change. Try again.

suspended.title: Access to {business} is paused for now
suspended.body: For details, contact the Ventora team at {email}.

home.soon: Your business’s apps will appear here.

account.title: Your account
account.lead: Your details, how Ventora looks for you and how you protect your account.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.lead: Choose where you want to hear about each one.

password.title: Password

done.title: Your password is changed.
done.body: You'll need to sign in again on your other devices.

password.signOutNote: You'll stay signed in on this device. We'll sign you out on the others.

twoStep.title: Two-step sign-in
twoStep.ownerBody: Required for the owner. Each time you sign in with your password, we also ask for a code from your authenticator app.
twoStep.offBody: Optional for your role. When it's on, each time you sign in with your password we also ask for a code from your authenticator app.
twoStep.onBody: Each time you sign in with your password, we also ask for a code from your authenticator app.
twoStep.disableBody: Your account will be protected by your password only, and your backup codes will stop working. Confirm with the code from your app.
twoStep.passwordLead: To turn on two-step sign-in, first confirm your account password.

codes.title: Backup codes
codes.body: Use them if you don't have your phone with you. You have {n} of 10 left. You see them only once, when you generate them.

empty.title: You have no new notifications
empty.body: We’ll tell you here when something needs you.

disconnected.title: The business phone is disconnected
disconnected.body: {n} reminders need to go out by {time}. Check the phone.

failing.title: Messages aren't going out
failing.body: {n} messages in a row didn't go out from {phone}.

reconnected.title: The business phone is connected again
reconnected.body: The waiting reminders have gone out.

newLinkRequested.title: {name} a cerut o invitație nouă pentru {businessName}.

email.why: Primești acest e-mail pentru că faci parte din echipa {businessName} în Ventora.
email.whyAccount: Primești acest e-mail pentru contul tău Ventora.

card.next: The payment has already been made with your {brand} ···· {last4} card; there’s nothing you need to do. You’ll always find the invoice in Plan and usage.

transfer.next: Please pay by bank transfer by {due}; the payment details are on the invoice. Once we receive the money, the invoice shows as “Paid”.

pack.next: The payment has already been made by card and the pack is active. There’s nothing you need to do.

renewal.lead: The bank declined the {amount} payment to renew your plan, with the {brand} ···· {last4} card. No money was taken.
renewal.next: Everything keeps working as usual. We’ll try again automatically on {retryDate}; if you update your card before then, we’ll use the new one.

pack.lead: The bank declined the {amount} payment for {item}. No money was taken and the pack wasn’t activated.
pack.next: Everything you already have keeps working. You can buy the pack again once you’ve updated your card.

retry.lead: We tried the {amount} payment again and the bank declined it. No money was taken.
retry.next: The last automatic attempt is on {retryDate}. To make sure it goes through, update your card before then; if you need help, write to support@ventorasystems.com.

lastRetry.lead: The last automatic attempt to pay {amount} for your plan was declined too. No money was taken.
lastRetry.next: Until {graceEnd}, everything works as usual for the whole team. If the payment isn’t made by then, the account becomes read-only, with export: you can see everything, but can’t add or change anything. Update your card and we’ll take the payment right away.

owner80.lead: {business} has used {used} of {limit} {resource} in the period ending on {resetDate}.
owner80.next: On {resetDate}, usage starts again from zero. If you need more before then, buy an extra pack; the limit goes up right away.

owner100.lead: {business} has used all {limit} {resource} in the period ending on {resetDate}.
owner100.next: Nothing you have is lost. To keep going before {resetDate}, buy an extra pack: the limit goes up right away. Otherwise, usage starts again from zero on {resetDate}.

planChange.next: Nothing changes until {date}. If another plan suits you better, you can request it in Plan and usage; if you have questions, write to support@ventorasystems.com.

ending.lead: You have 3 days left in your {app} trial.
ending.next: If you want to keep it, activate it: it’s {price} a month, with your plan. If not, the app stops on {date}, and everything you did in it stays; you can activate it any time later.

ended.lead: Your {app} trial has ended, so the app has stopped.
ended.next: Everything you did in {app} stays. If you activate it, you pick up where you left off.

accepted.lead: The Ventora team has accepted your request for {app} and will set it up for {business}.
accepted.next: Setup costs {setup}, once. After payment we start setting it up and let you know when the app is ready. After that, {app} is {price} a month, with your plan.

due.lead: Setting up {app} for {business} starts once the {setup} setup fee is paid.
due.next: If you’ve changed your mind or have questions, write to support@ventorasystems.com.

started.lead: We’ve finished the setup, and {app} is now running for {business}.
started.next: You’ll find it among the business’s apps. From today it’s {price} a month, with your plan; the first month is prorated.

owner.lead: The grace period ended on {date} without the {amount} plan payment, so {business} is now read-only, with export.
owner.next: Nothing has been lost: the whole team can see everything and export it, but can’t add or change anything. As soon as the payment goes through, everything works as before.

restored.lead: We’ve received the {amount} payment, and {business} is back to normal.
restored.next: The whole team can work as before; nothing was lost in the meantime. The invoice is in Plan and usage.

billing.subject: {title} · {business}
billing.why: You’re getting this email because you’re the owner of {business} in Ventora.
billing.upgrade: If this happens often, request another plan in Plan and usage.

prefs.title: Notifications
prefs.lead: You always get these in the app: they’re about your account and your work. By email, you choose, except for security.
prefs.securityNote: You always get these, in the app and by email, so you know right away if something changes in your account.

cat.phone: The business phone and messages to clients

news.title: News from Ventora
news.desc: What’s new in Ventora: apps, features, important changes.
news.emailDesc: Off until you turn it on.

reco.title: Ventora recommendations
reco.desc: Suggestions for apps and extra packs that fit what you already do.
reco.inAppDesc: You see them on pages and in notifications, under Recommendations.
reco.note: Messages about your account’s limits stay on, because they’re account information, not recommendations.

transfer.title: Invoice {number} has been issued
transfer.body: {what} · {amount} · to pay by bank transfer by {due}

renewal.title: The plan payment didn’t go through
renewal.body: No money was taken. We’ll try again on {retryDate}; until then, everything works as usual.

pack.title: The payment for {item} didn’t go through
pack.body: No money was taken and the pack wasn’t activated. You can try again with another card.

retry.title: The plan payment didn’t go through again
retry.body: No money was taken. The last automatic attempt is on {retryDate}; until then, everything works as usual.

lastRetry.title: The last payment attempt didn’t go through
lastRetry.body: No money was taken. Until {graceEnd}, everything works as usual; update your card so we can take the payment.

owner80.title: You’ve used 80% of your {resource} limit
owner80.body: {used} of {limit} until {resetDate}. If you need more, buy an extra pack.

owner100.title: You’ve reached your {resource} limit
owner100.body: Nothing you have is lost. To add more before {resetDate}, buy an extra pack.

other80.title: The business has used 80% of its {resource} limit
other80.body: {used} of {limit} until {resetDate}. Only {owner} (owner) can buy extra packs.

other100.title: The business has reached its {resource} limit
other100.body: Nothing is lost. Until {resetDate}, only {owner} (owner) can buy extra packs.

ending.title: Your {app} trial ends on {date}
ending.body: To keep it, activate it. Otherwise it stops, and your data stays.

ended.title: Your {app} trial has ended
ended.body: The app has stopped, and your data stays. You can activate it any time.

accepted.title: Your {app} request has been accepted
accepted.body: Setup costs {setup}, once. After payment, we set it up for you.

due.title: {app} setup is waiting for payment
due.body: {setup}, once. We start the setup after payment.

started.title: {app} is up and running
started.body: We’ve finished the setup. From today, {app} is {price} a month, with your plan.

owner.title: The business account is read-only
owner.body: The plan payment wasn’t made. You can all see and export everything; to work again, pay {amount}.

member.title: The business account is read-only
member.body: You can see and export everything. To work again, {owner} (owner) needs to make the payment.

restored.title: The business account is back to normal
restored.body: We’ve received the {amount} payment. The whole team can work as before.
